source:
Characters of Lady Lady God-damn Night show up and promise an unforgettable experience if player gets through the numerous keyboard practice exercises.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-february-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-february-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
